documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% year-on-year increase in revenue for Q1 FY27, reaching ₹ 472.2 crores. The company is executing a ~₹ 200 crore debottlenecking capex to expand its ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA by September 2026. Management expects optimal utilization of this expanded capacity by the end of FY28 while maintaining a debt-free balance sheet. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a decrease in annual revenue for FY26 while maintaining stable EBITDA and PAT growth. The company is currently executing a capacity expansion project to increase production from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA.

guidance.claim: Management expects optimal utilization of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for ABS resins is dominated by the appliances and automotive sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumption is being accelerated by EV adoption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight plastics for interior trims and battery housings.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for ABS will be driven by growth in consumer durables and the automotive sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores with margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 20.0%.
margins_costs.quote: for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

capital_allocation.claim: A debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk for the company.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a healthy dividend payout of over 50%.
capital_allocation.quote: Healthy dividend payout (~50%+)* reflects disciplined capital allocation and shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: A strong liquidity position provides a cushion against cyclicality and working capital shocks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Strong liquidity position, providing a cushion against cyclicality and working capital shocks.
